_comment: SYNTHETIC. A Playwright storage state as it would look after a bol login.
The cookie NAMES are confirmed - login.bol.com sets JSESSIONID and XSC, both
Secure and HttpOnly - and their HOSTS are the point of this fixture: JSESSIONID
is scoped to login.bol.com and would not travel to www.bol.com, exactly as a
browser would refuse to send it. Anything the fetch needs has to be scoped to
www.bol.com or to a dotted .bol.com, and BolCookies is written to agree.
The values are obviously fake and no real session is stored anywhere.
